{{Quote|There's a new group of criminals forming on Naboo. They call themselves the Naboo Criminal Coalition.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Typho]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|directory tree files}}</ref>}}
The '''Naboo Criminal Coalition''' was a criminal syndicate founded on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] sometimes after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The organization was fought by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Typho]] and the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Naboo Criminal Coalition appears in the directory tree files for the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> According to these files, introduced with the [[2005]] "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," the Naboo Criminal Coalition would have been involved in the Naboo part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]."<ref name="SWG" /> The [[Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide'': Prima Official Game Guide]] incorrectly states that the player has to fight the Naboo Criminal Coalition in the four ground quests given by Captain Typho.<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> In fact, it was the [[Maulers]] that were featured in those quest.<ref name="SWG:TPW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Typho - Police Work|Naboo}}</ref><ref name="SWG:TMPW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Typho - More Police Work|Naboo}}</ref><ref name="SWG:TSI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Typho - Stronghold Infiltration|Naboo}}</ref><ref name="SWG:TSE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Typho - Stronghold Elimination|Naboo}}</ref>
